Satyam Kumar Chaudhary (born ~2004, age 20), commonly known as Satyam Kumar or Satyam Chaudhary, and online as "codersatyam" or "sirsatyamchaudhary", is an Indian software engineer from Supaul, Bihar,
now based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He completed his Bachelor of Engineering in
Computer Science and Engineering at AVIT — Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology,
Chennai, graduating in 2025.

He is known online as "codersatyam" and by the email sirsatyamchaudhary@gmail.com.
His personal website is https://www.codersatyam.com.
